author: PIRUBY
description: AgentBoard installs into a Rails application and connects tickets to coding agents (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, Cursor and third-party adapters) through MCP, provider hooks, a supervised runtime daemon, isolated Git worktrees and evidence-based completion policies.

author: Yaroslav Shmarov
description: Send Noticed notifications through the Telegram Bot API: one message per recipient with `deliver_by :telegram`, or one message to a group, forum topic, or channel with `bulk_deliver_by :telegram`. The bot token is kept out of logs and error messages.
